title: ITRA — Quebec Mega Trail 135 km, 2026
claims: ITRA's 2026 QMT135 entry gives a race date of 2026/07/03, a 20:00 start, 133.74 km, +5,530 m, −5,359 m, a 30-hour time limit, 10 aid stations and 300 participants.
The same ITRA page's About the Race text describes a 160 km race, 39 hours and up to three pacers, contradicting its own course details.
ITRA gives the 135 km race mountain level 5 and finisher level 450.
